subtitle: One misread word and the entire model breaks — know your variations cold.
title: Ch 1.10 · Variation Lexicon
description: A 25‑round vocabulary drill on direct, inverse, joint, and combined variation. Spot the wrong term, match definitions, and sort equation types. No solving — just the precise language of mathematical modeling.
